description: Search YellowPages.com for local businesses by keyword + location, browse a category, or enrich specific business profile URLs.

categorySlug.description: YellowPages category slug, e.g. `plumbers`, `pizza`, `hair-salons`, `auto-repair-service`. Found in category browse URLs: yellowpages.com/{location}/{category}.
categorySlug.title: Category slug (mode=category)

detailUrls.description: Full YellowPages business profile URLs (containing `/mip/`), e.g. `https://www.yellowpages.com/new-york-ny/mip/some-business-123456`.
detailUrls.title: Business profile URLs (mode=businessDetail)

fetchBusinessDetails.description: For search/category modes, visit each business's profile page to add hours, general info, and services/products. Slower and less reliable — leave off for fast, reliable runs.
fetchBusinessDetails.title: Fetch full business details

geoLocationTerms.description: City + state (e.g. `New York, NY`) or a 5-digit ZIP code (e.g. `10005`).
geoLocationTerms.title: Location (mode=search)

hasWebsiteOnly.description: Only keep businesses that list a website link.
hasWebsiteOnly.title: Has a website only

minRating.description: Only keep businesses with at least this star rating.
minRating.title: Minimum rating (stars)

minReviewCount.description: Only keep businesses with at least this many reviews.
minReviewCount.title: Minimum review count

minYearsInBusiness.description: Only keep businesses that have been operating for at least this many years.
minYearsInBusiness.title: Minimum years in business

openNowOnly.description: Only keep businesses shown as currently open.
openNowOnly.title: Currently open only

searchTerms.description: What to search for, e.g. `restaurants`, `plumbers`, `Starbucks`. Leave blank to list all businesses at the location.
searchTerms.title: Search terms (mode=search)

sortBy.description: How YellowPages should order results (applies to search and category modes).
sortBy.title: Sort order

title: Yellow Pages Business Directory Scraper Input
